content_origin.description: Dialogue lines drawn from the television sitcom 'Friends' (Warner Bros. Television / NBC), attributed to the character Chandler Bing and 187 other named cast members (dominant: Monica Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Ross Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green; remainder are minor/guest characters).
content_origin.underlying_ip_owner_HYPOTHESIS: Warner Bros. Entertainment / NBCUniversal (original series copyright holders). Not independently verified from the parquet file, which carries no license or copyright field.
content_origin.dataset_construction_format: ShareGPT-style instruction-tuning pair format: each row is a 2-turn conversation object with turn[0].from='human' (short multi-line dialogue excerpt providing scene context, each line prefixed 'CharacterName: text') and turn[1].from='gpt' (the response line, presumed to be Chandler Bing's next line in the scene, per dataset framing).
content_origin.structured_metadata_present_in_file: None beyond the 'conversations' column itself -- no episode/season/scene identifiers, no license field, no author/curator field, no collection-date field.

licensing_and_ip_handling.policy_applied_in_this_transformation: This transformation deliberately AVOIDS reproducing the source dialogue. No quote database, no long verbatim phrase bank, and no scene/script reproduction is included in any chandleros/* artifact. Only short (<=~12 word) illustrative snippets appear where strictly necessary for a structural annotation, and abstracted paraphrase/templates are preferred throughout. All statistical/structural findings (frequencies, distributions, structural templates, rule sets) are treated as facts ABOUT the dataset's language patterns, not as republished creative content.
licensing_and_ip_handling.recommendation_for_downstream_engineers: Treat original dialogue as copyrighted, unlicensed input. Do not redistribute data.parquet itself as part of any derived product; only the abstracted/statistical chandleros/* artifacts are intended for downstream reuse.

collection_provenance: Unknown / not recorded in file. Presumed to be a community-assembled fine-tuning dataset (naming and structure match publicly known 'Friends character chatbot' fine-tuning corpora), but no verifiable source URL, author, or date-of-collection metadata is embedded in the parquet file itself.
data_integrity_hash_note: No checksum/hash was embedded in the source file; treat data.parquet as the single immutable reference copy for any future re-derivation of these artifacts.
